Post Text:
Hello,

I am currently seeking a reliable **dropshipping agent, sourcing agent, or direct manufacturer** to supply products for my baby and children?s brand.

I am looking for a long-term supplier who can source and provide **high-quality, preferably organic and natural baby products**, with the ability to customize the products and packaging with my company?s **brand name, logo, labeling, and packaging design**.

The product categories I am interested in include:

? Organic baby fruit & vegetable purees
? Baby rice snacks and other healthy baby snacks
? Baby cereals and grains
? Baby juices and natural beverages
? Infant formula and toddler nutrition products
? Baby diapers/pampers
? Baby wipes
? Other premium baby and toddler food, nutrition, and care products

I am particularly interested in **Caribbean-inspired flavors and ingredients** where possible, such as coconut, mango, banana, plantain, and other tropical fruits.

For food products, I am looking for suppliers with appropriate **FDA/food-safety certifications and manufacturing compliance**, as I intend to build a premium brand that can eventually enter major retail markets in the United States and the Caribbean.

Please provide the following information:

1. Company/manufacturer profile and years in business
2. Product catalog and available product categories
3. Organic certifications and food-safety certifications
4. FDA registration/compliance information, where applicable
5. Private-label/OEM capabilities
6. Minimum order quantities (MOQ)
7. Pricing for private-label products
8. Custom packaging and labeling options
9. Sample availability and sample costs
10. Production lead times
11. Monthly production capacity
12. Dropshipping capabilities, if available
13. Shipping options to the **Bahamas, United States, and Caribbean**
14. Available shipping terms (EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP, etc.)
15. Existing international export markets
16. Whether you can consolidate multiple products into one shipment
17. Product shelf life and storage requirements
18. Product testing and certificates of analysis (COA), where applicable

I am interested in establishing a **long-term business relationship** with a dependable supplier rather than making a one-time purchase.

If you can supply these products or have access to qualified manufacturers that can produce them under my brand, please send me your company profile, product catalog, certifications, MOQ requirements, and wholesale/private-label pricing.

Thank you. I look forward to hearing from you and discussing a potential partnership.
